import { ShapeLexEngine, type CompactMatch } from "shapelex-mcp";

const engine = new ShapeLexEngine({ persistent: false });
const compressed = engine.compressText({
  text: "ShapeLex package consumers can import the public engine and its declared types."
});
const match: CompactMatch = {
  uri: compressed.uri,
  matchKind: "exact",
  score: 1,
  exact: true,
  mustExpand: false,
  criticalDiff: false
};

console.log(match.uri);
